title: Defaulted gate lookup
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with an ordered list of gates, and let $i$ be a natural number strictly less than the number of gates. Then the list lookup at index $i$, using the constant-true gate as a default, equals the gate at index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is less than the length of the gate list
